title: Connector test could reach private and cluster addresses
problem: The connector Test fetched any URL from the API pod with redirects and no private-address guard, and counted 4xx as success.
fix: A shared outbound URL guard checks every hop, private targets need CONNECTORS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_TARGETS, and only 2xx or 3xx count as reachable.

title: Connectors sent an Abenix API key prefix as their credential
problem: secret_ref pointed at an Abenix API key and its prefix was sent to the outside system.
fix: Connector secrets are write-only and stored encrypted per tenant. Old connectors are flagged to re-enter their secret and never send the key.

title: An agent could call another tenant's connector by id
problem: connector_call loaded any connector by id regardless of tenant.
fix: Connectors are loaded only within the run's tenant.

title: Members could see other users' runs in the executions list
problem: Only the counts were scoped to the member, the rows were not.
fix: Rows follow the same scope as counts, and the status filter no longer errors.

title: GDPR erase never scrubbed the account
problem: The scrub wrote to a column that does not exist, so erased accounts kept their email and name, and a failed step returned 500.
fix: The scrub uses the real columns with a test that checks each column exists, and the router no longer reads an expired user.

title: Moderation stored matched secrets in clear
problem: Event previews kept the matched text, for example an SSN, and queued runs recorded no moderation events at all.
fix: Matches are masked for every category, queued runs record their events, and a retention policy purges previews and held content.

title: A held reply could be glimpsed before the check
problem: The reply streamed to the member before the output check decided to hold it.
fix: When a policy can hold, block or redact output the reply is buffered and the member sees a checking state, then the reply or the hold card.

title: Approvals could not open inside the cluster
problem: The runtime had no API address in cluster and fell back to localhost, so Asks first and approval_gate failed.
fix: The runtime uses the in-cluster API service address and helm sets INTERNAL_API_URL.

title: The sample plant limits never published
problem: Golden tests compared only ok while results carried a reason, so every action was blocked.
fix: Expected results match exactly, the sample repairs itself and the grant page shows a banner when limits cannot be checked.

title: AI-built pipelines passed missing values between steps
problem: The builder taught step.response for tools that return body or text, so steps got not available and still showed completed.
fix: The prompt lists real output fields, the engine reads a step's main output, and steps after a failure no longer run.

title: Run Pipeline never asked for inputs
problem: Running from the builder started step one with nothing.
fix: A run dialog asks for the inputs and failed steps show their error inline with a Diagnose and fix link.

title: ML output could not be read by pipelines
problem: The ml_model tool returned text followed by JSON.
fix: It returns JSON with the prediction on top.

title: Failed tool calls showed as completed in chat
problem: The stream event carried no error flag.
fix: Tool results carry is_error and chat shows failed.

title: An invalid cron expression crashed the app
problem: An error object was rendered as text.
fix: Errors render as plain messages, with presets and validation before submit.

title: Pages were blank or silently redirected for people without access
problem: Admin pages showed nothing to non-admins and some bounced to the dashboard.
fix: One shared screen explains who can use a page and links onward, on every gated page.

title: Several pages scrolled sideways on phones
problem: Agents, Source Watch, Analytics, Moderation, Scaling and Help overflowed at 390 px.
fix: Layouts wrap and tables scroll inside their own box.

title: Next.js and sharp advisories in every web app
problem: Next.js cache poisoning and the sharp librsvg advisory were open across the platform and standalone apps.
